spans.claim: Joseph Maillard was shot twice through the heart
spans.anchor: Dead," he said, curtly. "Shot twice--each bullet through the heart.
spans.span: Dead," he said, curtly. "Shot twice--each bullet through the heart. Judge Forester, I'm afraid there is no alternative but to call in the police.

spans.claim: Bob Maillard was found changing out of an aviator's uniform
spans.anchor: Five minutes afterward he was found in a near-by room, hastily changing out of an aviator's uniform into his masquerade costume.
spans.span: Five minutes afterward he was found in a near-by room, hastily changing out of an aviator's uniform into his masquerade costume. Obviously, he had assumed the guise of the Masquer as a joke on his friends, and the joke had a tragic ending.

spans.claim: Ben Chacherre was found with the stolen loot and aviator's costume
spans.anchor: Ben Chacherre, who had stolen the loot and the aviator's costume, was arrested.

spans.claim: Jachin Fell is a lawyer and chess master with mysterious connections
spans.anchor: Jachin Fell was a member of the most exclusive New Orleans clubs. He was even received in the inner circles of Creole society.

spans.claim: The oil seepage on Lucie Ledanois' land was planted by Fell
spans.anchor: I planted that oil seepage myself--or had it done by men I could trust," said Jachin Fell, calmly.
spans.span: Merely that I planted that oil seepage myself--or had it done by men I could trust," said Jachin Fell, calmly. He sat back in his chair and took up his cigar with an air of finality.

spans.claim: Gramont was the original Midnight Masquer acting to expose the gang
spans.anchor: Yes. One reason was that I suspected someone in society, someone high up in New Orleans, to be connected with the gang; but I never dreamed that you were the man, Fell.
spans.span: Yes. One reason was that I suspected someone in society, someone high up in New Orleans, to be connected with the gang; but I never dreamed that you were the man, Fell. I rather suspected young Maillard.

spans.claim: Ben Chacherre murdered the sheriff and Joseph Maillard
spans.anchor: Ben Chacherre is charged with the murder of the sheriff of Terrebonne Parish, in which I have clear evidence against him.

spans.claim: Fell is protected by government secrecy as a special agent
spans.anchor: I am a special agent of the Department of Justice, employed in that capacity through the efforts of Judge Forester and Senator Flaxman.
spans.span: These gentlemen will tell you that I am a special agent of the Department of Justice, employed in that capacity through the efforts of Judge Forester and Senator Flaxman. I regret that this had to be held so secret that not even the governor himself was aware of it until this evening.

spans.claim: Gramont arrests Memphis Izzy Gumberts and gang members
spans.anchor: I went out to the Gumberts place on Bayou Terrebonne this morning, arrested Memphis Izzy Gumberts and four other men engaged in operating a lottery.

spans.claim: The aviator's automatic pistol was used to kill Joseph Maillard
spans.anchor: The Midnight Masquer had fired two bullets into Maillard. Two cartridges were gone from this automatic.
spans.span: The Midnight Masquer had fired two bullets into Maillard. Two cartridges were gone from this automatic. CHAPTER XV _When the Heavens Fall_ The chief of police entered the office of Jachin Fell, high in the Maison Blanche building, at eight o'clock on Friday evening.

spans.claim: Gramont is wounded by Charlie the Goog during the arrest
spans.anchor: Charlie the Goog lay dead on the floor--a touch of heroic tragedy in his last desperate action; he had got me in the arm.

spans.claim: Fell threatens Gramont to vote with him on the oil deal
spans.anchor: I want you to vote with me--and I'm going to put my cards on the table before you.

spans.claim: Fell admits planting the oil seepage to enrich Lucie Ledanois
spans.anchor: I planted that oil seepage myself--or had it done by men I could trust.

spans.claim: Gramont calls the governor to confirm Fell's arrest
spans.anchor: I called up the governor, and have been told not to arrest him.

spans.claim: Fell reveals he is a government agent to avoid arrest
spans.anchor: I have done this by the authority of the United States, in order to apprehend Memphis Izzy Gumberts and other men at one crack.
spans.span: I have done this by the authority of the United States, in order to apprehend Memphis Izzy Gumberts and other men at one crack. These gentlemen will tell you that I am a special agent of the Department of Justice, employed in that capacity through the efforts of Judge Forester and Senator Flaxman.

spans.claim: Gramont has the evidence to put the lottery business into Federal hands
spans.anchor: I have secured an abundance of evidence to prove that the lottery gang has extended its operations to adjacent states.

spans.claim: Fell is arrested as the head of the criminal gang
spans.anchor: I now call upon you to hold him in custody as a Federal prisoner.
spans.span: I have disregarded these facts, and I now call upon you to hold him in custody as a Federal prisoner. He has boasted to me that you will not touch him--and if you don't, there's going to be a shakeup that will make history!

spans.claim: Lucie Ledanois is made financially secure through the oil deal
spans.anchor: I shall see to it that you will not be injured because of that signed statement.
spans.span: Even if no oil is ever found there, I shall see to it that you will not be injured because of that signed statement." Gramont nodded dull comprehension.

spans.claim: The Midnight Masquer's loot was returned to the owners
spans.anchor: A number of people have received back property this afternoon--loot the bandit had taken.

spans.claim: Ben Chacherre tries to frame Hammond for murder
spans.anchor: They claim I done it----
